_provenance.what: The largest share of a specimen that may be assigned OUTSIDE the blood lineage before the immune tier is withheld. The gauge is commissioned on whole blood; beyond this the reading is still reported but no tier word is printed.
_provenance.detector: 1 - (immune + progenitor + stem_adult), from the composition the chain already computes
_provenance.calibrated_on: the 318 healthy whole-blood arrays of PROC-BAND-01, four laboratories; the threshold is the largest value firing on at most 15 of 318 (0.0472), which is the <= 0.05 false-positive rate the pre-registration fixed
_provenance.measured: at every mixing fraction where >= 10 % of hosts changed tier, this threshold caught >= 95.9 % of those hosts (PROC_FOREIGN_01.json)
_provenance.fallback: a specimen whose composition cannot be computed is NOT withheld by this guard
